challenges.description: Read n and print the sum of integers from 1 through n.
challenges.hint: Use a loop and an accumulator.

challenges.title: List Maximum
challenges.description: Read space-separated integers and print the largest value.
challenges.hint: Convert the split text to integers, then inspect the values.

challenges.title: Word Counter
challenges.description: Read a sentence and print how many words it contains.
challenges.hint: strip() and split() are useful here.

challenges.title: Linear Search
challenges.description: Read a target on the first line and a space-separated list on the second line. Print the zero-based index or -1.
challenges.hint: Scan from left to right and stop at the first match.

challenges.title: Safe Division
challenges.description: Read a and b on one line. Print a/b. If b is zero, print Cannot divide by zero.
challenges.hint: Handle ZeroDivisionError or check b before dividing.

challenges.title: Book Status
challenges.description: Read a book title and a status (yes/no). Print Available when the status is yes, otherwise Borrowed.
challenges.hint: Model the status with a boolean or a simple comparison.

challenges.title: Error Code Extractor
challenges.description: Read a line of text and print ERROR codes such as E12 separated by spaces.
challenges.hint: A regular expression like r"E\d+" matches this pattern.

challenges.title: Command Router
challenges.description: Read a command. Print Run when it is run, Help when it is help, otherwise Unknown command.
challenges.hint: Keep command handling explicit and predictable.

challenges.title: Expense Summary
challenges.description: Read space-separated amounts. Print count, a slash, and total (example: 3 / 600).
challenges.hint: Convert to integers, count them, and sum them.
